variants.headline: Still in view: building project badly behind schedule
variants.body:
The project {project} is badly behind schedule. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

The gazette records the serious delay without describing the project as cancelled or abandoned. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
